crossRefs.note: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”

people.name: Peniel
people.line: A place where Jacob wrestled with God

translations.web: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.
translations.bsb: He also pulled down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
translations.kjv: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
translations.asv: And he brake down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
